stops.note: used of men who left their tribe to live free on the steppe; the name 'Kazakh' comes from the same word
frontier warrior communities formed the Zaporozhian Host, based on islands below the Dnieper rapids from the 1550s
Don Cossacks and others guarded and pushed forward Russia's steppe frontier, later leading the conquest of Siberia
first recorded in English accounts of Russia and Poland

current_meaning: a member of the free warrior communities of the Ukrainian and Russian steppe frontier
